notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Activate Scroll Rack by paying {1}, and tapping it, exiling seven cards from your hand, putting the top seven cards of your library into your hand, then putting the exiled cards on top of your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.
